The patient is a 15-year-old male with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy diagnosed in January 2020 and prior orthopedic evaluation in May 2020 who presents with persistent intermittent left-sided chest pain of four days duration. The patient, with hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy since his 2020 cardiology evaluation and prior assessment for exertional chest pain in 2021, presents following a syncopal episode. His parents state that he briefly lost consciousness but recovered quickly without confusion or incontinence.
An echocardiogram is ordered to evaluate the underlying cause of his symptoms.

profile.summaryLine: Tyler is a 14-year-old who values soccer and wants clear, direct communication as he manages hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy.

emotionalContext.text: Soccer is extremely important to Tyler and central to his identity.

Recent episodes of chest pain, palpitations, and loss of consciousness during sports may cause anxiety or concern for Tyler and his mother.
